description: This file implements internationalization (i18n) support for a Vue.js application, including translation functions, API integration for language data, and Vue mixin setup.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Factory function returning a translation function that formats messages using IntlMessageFormat and handles errors.

methods.name: defineMixin
methods.description: Defines a Vue mixin that assigns the translation function to the component's $t property.

methods.name: createI18n
methods.description: Initializes internationalization by fetching language data via API, setting up translation formats, and registering Vue mixins.
